text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Newly-appointed Moroccan ambassador in Algeria presents credentials to President Liamine Zeroual.

- Casablanca, the business capital, in the limelight with government plans to develop its 35 local councils. It seeks increased tax receipts without weighing heavily on taxpayers, better hygiene and transport.

- State-owned water utility (ONEP) starts implementing a 2 billion dirhams ($217 million ) programme to supply more rural areas with water in 1997. It will be financed at 58 percent by the European Union, a French fund and European investment bank and is part of a broader plan to generalise access to water by the year 2005.
- Central bank circular to allow banks to operate cross-trade currencies with foreign banks is new step towards liberalisation of exchanges.
